content.text: Skip to ArticleUnlimited Digital Access -Start Today for $1 - Sale Ends 5/3/26CloseCleveland Guardians, Atlanta Braves starting lineups for April 11, 2026: Game 15Updated: Apr. 11, 2026, 4:02 p.m.|Published: Apr. 11, 2026, 3:53 p.m.Parker Messick, Cleveland Guardians.APBy Joe Noga, cleveland.comATLANTA — Parker Messick and the Guardians face the Braves in Game 2 of a weekend series in Atlanta.Here are the starting lineups for Saturday’s game between the Guardians and Braves.Where: Truist Park, 7:15 p.m. ET.TV/radio: CLEGuardians.TV, WTAM 1100 AM, WMMS 100.7 FM and the Guardians Radio Network will carry the game.Teams: Guardians (8-6) vs. Braves (9-5).Starting pitchers: LHP Parker Messick (1-0, 0.82) vs. LHP Martín Pérez (0-0, 3.86).Stephen Vogt just said what everyone was thinking about the GuardiansIs the Guardians catcher rotation strategy backfiring?José Ramírez just broke another century-old record — and nobody’s surprised anymoreHow to watch the Guardians: See how to watch Guardians games with this handy game-by-game TV schedule.GUARDIANSCF Steven Kwan.LF Angel Martínez.3B José Ramírez.RF David Fry.DH Chase DeLauter.1B Rhys Hoskins.2B Juan Brito.C Austin Hedges.SS Brayan Rocchio.BRAVESRF Ronald Acuña Jr.DH Drake Baldwin.2B Ozzie Albies.1B Matt Olson.3B Austin Riley.CF Mauricio Dubón.LF Mike Yastrzemski.C Jonah Heim.SS Jorge Mateo.
